title: SimulationStart
description: The body telemetry POSTs to a simulator's /control/start: the building and the sensors that simulator is to simulate, replacing whatever it held for the building. Built by telemetry in Rust, parsed by sensor-simulator in TypeScript and aq-simulator and ap-simulator in Python.
$comment: No targetUrl: a simulator posts to its own TELEMETRY_INGEST_URL, so no caller can redirect its signed readings.

sensors.description: May be empty: the simulator then stops simulating the building.

rooms.description: Optional building geometry: every room, including rooms with no sensor. Absent means the caller has none; never empty.

sensorType.description: A device kind from telemetry's catalog, never a metric.

roomId.description: Readings are room-keyed, so an outdoor sensor is never sent.

position.description: Where the twin places the sensor; absent when it is not placed yet.
The footprint centre at floor level.

dimensions.description: Width along x, height up y, depth along z.
